about_the_game:
Hunkfrat is a fast-paced, First Person Shooter where you fight, die and fight again to reclaim your Frat drinks, beverages that is extremely important to Hunkfrat, as you push through linear, action-packed stages. You’ll have to get to the end in order to get back your drinks, but you're not strong enough to do it in first try. That's why you will have to upgrade yourself, get new weapons and ammunation, then start it all over to reach a better point.

Combat

 Hunkfrat delivers a dynamic, high-reaction combat experience. Use your weapons to take down enemies. Every encounter and distance progression rewards you with money, which you can spend back at your home using the supplier to purchase new weapons, supplies and upgrades.

Progression

 Fight Wimp Gang members across a variety of locations throughout the stages to get back your drinks. Each death is not the end, but a new start. You will be rewarded with money as the distance you travelled. You can then return home to gear up with new weapons and upgrades. Every run gives you more money, allowing you to get stronger as you progress.

If you’re looking for a fast, chaotic, and fun FPS experience, it’s time to jump into the fight and take back your legendary Frat drinks!

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains depictions of blood, violence, and death, as well as strong language. It also includes references to alcohol, tobacco, and illegal drugs. All such elements are presented in a humorous and exaggerated tone and does not induce usage of any elements referred. The game does not include nudity, sexual content, or extreme violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10-11
  • Processor: Intel I3 10100f / Amd Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce Gtx 1070 8GB / Amd Rx 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Your favorite drinks have been stolen, and you have to get them back! But you will have to die over and over again to unlock new weapons and better upgrades in order to progress further in this stylised first person shooter.
